title: ESP32-S3 upstream refresh A/B at kixel-ai/rind `8a5977ad`, CPU at 240 MHz
board: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 class board, ESP32-S3 rev v0.2, 8 MB flash, USB-Serial/JTAG; the board whose MAC ends 3D:C8

toolchain.rustc: rustc 1.97.0-nightly (8ea53bcd7 2026-07-08) (esp 1.97.0.0), xtensa-esp32s3-none-elf, opt-level 3, lto fat, codegen-units 1

harness: WS-BENCH firmware for the S3 (private copy of the student repo's firmware-s3, not published here): ChaCha20-Poly1305 seal/open, Ed25519 and SHA-512 for rind and RustCrypto/dalek. A row is the firmware's median of `iters` timed samples (32, or 8 for Ed25519).
note: Control of an interleaved A/B on one ESP32-S3. Each run is one flash of the control image; the run's value is the median over that boot's complete rounds. Every flash of every image is in ab.json.

ctl.what: kixel-ai/rind main 8a5977ad as it is (HACL* Poly1305 in u64 limbs, HACL* ChaCha20; rolled SHA-512 is upstream's default here, #944)

zero.what: + key wipe as one memset on Xtensa

rot.what: + ChaCha20 rotates as ssai/src (rounds4), with the word XOR (#295 head)

notag.what: #296 at d3f3374f with a bench-only local patch that keeps the u64 tag add (branchless block loop only); not on any branch

poly.what: + branchless Poly1305 block loop and 16-bit-halves tag add (#296 at d3f3374f)

results_intro: The tables below are the control image. [ab.md](ab.md) has every image against the control, [RUNS.md](RUNS.md) every control run, and [NOTES.md](NOTES.md) the method, the run counts and what each image is.
results_ab: [ab.md](ab.md) has every image against the control, flash by flash. Images flashed fewer than three times do not meet the three-run rule; [NOTES.md](NOTES.md) says which.
